summary: Create a repository under Automation Content > Repositories with name, description, retained number of versions (null keeps all), pipeline (Staging: anyone publishes; Approved: via staging approval; None: direct publish by permitted users), Hide from search, Make private and an optional remote to sync from.
questions: How do I create a custom repository in automation hub?
What do the Staging, Approved and None pipeline options mean?
How many repository versions are retained?
How do I make an automation hub repository private?

answer_card.title: Repository pipeline options
answer_card.answer_md:
| Pipeline | Who can publish |
|---|---|
| **Staging** | anyone allowed to upload; goes to approval |
| **Approved** | only via approval from a staging repo (auto approve promotes to all approved repos) |
| **None** | users with repo permissions, directly; no approval |

*Retained number of versions*: 0 to unlimited; leave null to keep all (lets you revert).
